mode: read-only requirements analysis; no schematic, model or PCB mutations

POWER/R1.note: Base 0.28 ohm 1% 0.5W current shunt, unchanged for both batteries. Thermal option adds R56 upstream. CN3722 CSP senses upstream of R56, BAT downstream of R1; Kelvin connections. Cold ~96mA; warm ~665mA with three parallel AO3401A; bypass/no thermal nominal 714mA.

POWER/R40.note: 22mOhm series with the whole capacitor bank, not with load current.

POWER/R41.note: 22mOhm series with the whole capacitor bank, not with load current.

POWER/R55.note: 47mOhm series resistor after local TPS63802 C14/FB sense, before L3. Voltage loss I*0.047 ohm, dissipated power I^2*0.047 ohm.

POWER/R56.note: Optional cold-current series shunt 1.8 ohm 1%, in series with R1 0.28 ohm. Cold CC approximately96mA, dissipation approximately16.6mW. LTO or no-thermal build: fit0R jumper here; R1 stays0.28ohm.

POWER/R71.note: 0.1 ohm stock INA219 calibration. Kelvin pickups at inner shunt pad edges. Normal 1.25A causes 125mV drop and 156mW; 1W device is not qualified for continuous 4A. TCR +/-600ppm/C for chosen Yageo 0.1ohm.

POWER/J8.note: Mechanical v2 package; original functional pin numbers retained.

POWER/J12.note: 4 positions: pins1..3 preserve former LTO nets; pin4 is NC. Matching4pole cable housing required. Mechanical v2 package; original functional pin numbers retained.

POWER/J101.note: Direct vertical connection through 12 isolated screen holes. Mirrored female pad grid gives physical 1:1 after LOGIC X180. Pin7 returns SYS_3V3 to INA219 only; remove J11 before USB as before. Exact generic pin section and mating limits require sample check.

LOGIC/J11.note: U type1, A3.00 solder tail,B6.00 mating length,C6.07 abovePCB. Do not subtractAfromC. Mechanical v2 package; original functional pin numbers retained.

LOGIC/J201.note: Direct vertical connection through 12 isolated screen holes. Mirrored female pad grid gives physical 1:1 after LOGIC X180. Pin7 returns SYS_3V3 to INA219 only; remove J11 before USB as before. Exact generic pin section and mating limits require sample check.

LOGIC/FB1.note: Separate radio supply branch. Ferrite60ohm at100MHz, conservative3A rating, DCRmax20mohm specifiedbyMurata. Nominal3mVdropat150mA. CustomCu lands per archivedMurataC31E6; mask/paste engineering choices. Prototype load-step/noise/resonance qualification required.

LOGIC/M2.note: HT-RA62 antenna through pin 1 ANT to J13 SMA. Module RF selector: fit R1=0 ohm for ANT; remove/do not fit R2 for IPEX. HF/LF band variant must match the antenna and firmware.

LOGIC/C23.note: Local22uF25V0805 radio bypass afterFB1; exactsameDanomskpartasC14. DC-biased effective capacitance requires prototype qualification.

LOGIC/C24.note: Local100nF radio bypass directly between M2 VCC/GND, afterFB1.

LOGIC/U6.note: User project watchdog/main.c: PB3 rising-edge heartbeat, PB0 open-drain reset. 1350 WDT ticks (~3h) then1s reset; source firmware unchanged. Danomsk S4.6 approved substitution. Совпадает точный MPN; в наличии две детали.

LOGIC/R38.note: Watchdog monitors modem TXEN at user request; no MCU heartbeat GPIO. Danomsk S4.6 approved substitution. 1kΩ, 0805, 1%; Yageo вместо Uni-Ohm. Покупка кратно 10 шт.

LOGIC/R39.note: Required pulldown from the source watchdog project; idle input is low. Danomsk S4.6 approved substitution. 100kΩ, 0805, 1%; Yageo вместо Uni-Ohm. Покупка кратно 10 шт.

LOGIC/NT1.note: Permanent RF copper bypass under optional FL1. Not a purchased component. Leave continuous when FL1 is absent; cut central bar before fitting FL1. Inspect complete isolation before soldering the filter.

LOGIC/R37.note: Removable reset link: remove before ISP, restore after programming. PB0 must only sink or float in normal use. Danomsk S4.6 approved substitution. 0Ω, 0805; замена обычной перемычки по назначению. Покупка кратно 10 шт.

LOGIC/Q2.note: GPS high-side switch; AO3401A AOS, G1 S2 D3. Default off through R42; driven low by Q3.

LOGIC/Q3.note: CJ 2N7002K SOT23, G1 S2 D3. Sink only 33uA from R42. P0.24 HIGH enables GPS.

USB_behavior: With J11 removed, SYS_3V3 still powers RADIO_3V3 through copper NT2 star on POWER; FILTER_OUT remains disconnected. NiceNano USB supplies logic/peripherals and modem, including POWER INA219. There is no separate modem power switch; watchdog performs logic reset, GPS has its own Q2 PMOS/Q3 NMOS switch.
